items.name: Descent magazine subscription
items.shortDescription: The UK's premier caving magazine
items.longDescription: A subscription to Descent magazine would be wonderful - it's the main magazine covering caving, cave exploration, and underground adventures in the UK and beyond.

items.name: Old Descent magazines
items.shortDescription: Any issues from the last 15 years
items.longDescription: I'd love to read back issues of Descent magazine from roughly 2010 onwards. Any copies you have lying around or can find second-hand would be really interesting to read.

items.name: Spare caving light
items.shortDescription: A backup light for underground adventures
items.longDescription: You can never have too many caving lights! A spare headtorch or helmet-mounted light suitable for caving would be very useful as a backup. Check the Caving Gear Exchange UK Facebook group for second-hand options.

items.name: Cheap, robust remote control car
items.shortDescription: Want to make me smile on Christmas day?
items.longDescription: Not just when I open the present but for the rest of the day too! Find a cheap remote control car (second hand is absolutely fine) and make sure it has batteries or is charged and you're good to go. Simple fun for everyone.

items.name: Heated socks
items.shortDescription: More heated socks please!
items.longDescription: I love heated socks for keeping warm - can never have too many pairs. Link to follow.

items.name: Strong mature cheddar
items.shortDescription: Because I love cheese
items.longDescription: All gift of cheddar cheese is welcome. No cheddar is too strong. Much more of a fan of cheddar than, say, fancy french cheeses

items.name: Moorland Grit guidebook
items.shortDescription: A climbing guidebook that I won't use
items.longDescription: I don't think I will climb anything in it, but it's a guidebook of esoteric underclimbed, pieces of rock round Glossop. Rock probably best looked at rather than climbed, which is what makes the guidebook likely more fun than climbing them.

items.name: 170W ThinkPad Chargers
items.shortDescription: Must be 170W - less powerful chargers won't work on my laptop
items.longDescription: Rectangle-ended tip suitable for P50/P52 etc - second hand recommended. The link has many suitable ones that would all work.

items.name: New laptop keyboard
items.shortDescription: Replacement keyboard for my ThinkPad
items.longDescription: A replacement keyboard for my laptop. Link to follow.

items.name: Laptop RAM
items.shortDescription: More memory for my laptop
items.longDescription: Additional RAM to upgrade my laptop. Link to follow.

items.name: Replacement van lights
items.shortDescription: New lights for the van
items.longDescription: Replacement lights for my van. Link to follow.

items.name: Contributions towards van bodywork
items.shortDescription: Help fix up the van
items.longDescription: My van needs some bodywork repairs. Any contributions towards getting this done would be very welcome!

items.name: Detailed field first aid kit
items.shortDescription: For Tim and Jen - PLEASE CONSULT BEFORE BUYING
items.longDescription: We'd like a detailed, well-stocked field first aid kit with specific items. Please consult with Tim or Jen before buying this - don't randomly buy a £2 first aid kit! We have particular requirements. Link to follow.

items.name: Walkie talkies
items.shortDescription: For outdoor adventures and communication
items.longDescription: Walkie talkies for outdoor use. Link to follow.

items.name: USB-C to USB-A cables
items.shortDescription: I need about 6 more
items.longDescription: Second hand/preloved welcome!

items.name: 4TB 2.5" Internal Hard Drive
items.shortDescription: I'd like to be able to hold more photos in my laptop
items.longDescription: I have a 2TB HDD, and a 4TB disk would let me do more work and hold more photos of James! The one linked will fit my laptop.

items.name: Basic headphones
items.shortDescription: I can never have enough 3.5mm headphones with microphones.
items.longDescription: Please not bluetooth ones. The ones linked are my favourite model, but all headphones gratefully recieved.

items.name: Laser Printer
items.shortDescription: We now have one - thank you!
items.longDescription: This has been acquired - no longer needed.

items.name: Technical Gore-tex waterproof jacket
items.shortDescription: To keep me warm and dry in the rain.
items.longDescription: I have an old goretex ME jacket, but it's starting to become a bit like swiss cheese - something not known for waterproofness. I've put a link to a ME Pro Shell in Large - but there are many other suitable jackets.

items.name: Wild Spirit by Helen Lloyd
items.shortDescription: My friend wrote this book and I'd love to read it.
items.longDescription: Unsolicited book recommendation: her other books are fantastic. Sadly I already own them.

items.name: AI credits
items.shortDescription: Credits for Claude AI - which I use daily
items.longDescription: I find myself finding Anthropic's Claude API extremely helpful and taking up some of my money. It helps me do things faster, better than ever before and I'm finding it extremely helpful. I sometimes spend about $2 per day on it, and it easily is delivering £10 of value to me each time. Money towards it would be warmly welcomed.

items.name: Babysitting
items.shortDescription: Time to help look after James - even 30 minutes makes a difference
items.longDescription: Having someone watch James, even for a short while, gives us a chance to do essential tasks or have a brief rest. This gift of time is incredibly valuable to us. No special skills needed - just patience and enthusiasm!

items.name: Sentimental items
items.shortDescription: Photos or mementos of times we've shared together
items.longDescription: I'd love photos of us doing things together, or items that help us remember shared experiences. Could be recent or from years ago - anything that might remind me of shared memories.

items.name: Chopped Firewood
items.shortDescription: We have a small stove
items.longDescription: As much as I'd love some massive pieces of tree, without a chainsaw and appropriate knowledge, any firewood would be best in stove size portions.

items.name: A stress-free Christmas
items.shortDescription: Would be dreamy
items.longDescription: We all can try

items.name: Drysuit (Large/XL)
items.shortDescription: For year-round kayaking comfort
items.longDescription: A waterproof drysuit (size Large or XL) would let me kayak in colder weather without getting cold. Look for reputable brands like Palm, Kokatat, or Gul. Second-hand in good condition is perfectly acceptable!

items.name: Lidl or Aldi Penne
items.shortDescription: The cheap pasta that just hits different
items.longDescription: Yes, this is partly a joke gift. But also, there's something about the cheap Lidl/Aldi penne that just works better than fancy pasta. I will genuinely eat and enjoy this. Multiple bags welcome!

notes.bookNote: Currently have plenty of books - prefer other gifts unless specifically listed

archivedItems.name: Chainsaw cutting course
archivedItems.shortDescription: Because I'd like to learn to chop wood effectively
archivedItems.longDescription: But I'd also like to keep all my fingers, and most of my face, so probs ideal to do it safeishly.

archivedItems.name: Stick (MMA) welding course
archivedItems.longDescription: It could be fun to know how to stick bits of metal together. It might become - to some degree - like learning to "paint" in metal.

archivedItems.name: Kayak Rolling Course
archivedItems.shortDescription: 90-minute session to develop whitewater kayak roll technique
archivedItems.longDescription: A private session in a heated pool with an instructor to develop and improve kayak rolling technique. This fundamental skill would help me be more confident in whitewater. Sessions are 90 minutes long and include instruction and boat use if needed.
